notes.title: Bigfixes and Quality of Life
notes.content:
Removed Ceiling from Journey level.

Player ship blows up if falling to far below the level (it used to be that you could fall forever and if you were moving to the right you would never die to level scroll).

Fixed crash where improperly spawned ateroids fail to despawn.

notes.title: 10 Years of Moon Bus
notes.content:
Moon Bus was originally released on March 25th 2013 and I've decided to release an update to celebrate 10 years!

We tallied the numbers and calculated Moon Bus's #1 fan and we've added a new ship to honor them, boot up the game to see who it is :o

I also snuck in a new level which contains more screens than all the other levels combined!

A big thank you to all of my fans who have played Moon Bus over the years.

I wish you all a very 4 passengers of the same colour.

Cheers,
Ian
